Taylor Nguyen: Hi team, quick onboarding question: I'm planning a smoke + rotation test tomorrow that will hit the hosted API and rotate keys mid-run. About ~1.5k requests over 30m, with a key swap at +15m. Any pitfalls I should watch for (rate limits, key propagation delays, metrics)?
Diego Morales: Welcome Taylor! Two things: 1) key rotation is immediate for most internal flows but clients using long-lived HTTP/2 streams can keep auth until reconnect; 2) rate limits are per-key and per-project bucket, so swapping to a fresh hosted key can avoid 429s if you hit a single-key cap.
Taylor Nguyen: Good to know. How do I create a short-lived hosted key tied to my user so I don't touch production credentials?
Rashida Ali: Ops can mint an ephemeral hosted key for you. Please open an OPS ticket with start/end times, test qps, and whether you'll stream. We can also create two ephemeral keys so you can rotate without downtime.
Taylor Nguyen: Perfect. What's the preferred wording for the ticket?
Rashida Ali: Something like: "Request ephemeral hosted keys: user Taylor Nguyen, keys: 2, window: 2026-03-25 14:00-14:30 UTC, expected 1500 requests total, streaming: yes, model: redwood-large". Also include your devbox IP if you want whitelist.
Taylor Nguyen: Ticket filed OPS-4957 with that text. I included IP 34.200.11.7.
ops-bot: OPS-4957 created and assigned to Rashida Ali.
Diego Morales: Two tips: 1) Watch the response headers for rate-limit info - we return X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and Retry-After when you hit a 429. 2) For streaming, some SDKs expose an ondisconnect handler — plan to reconnect on auth failures.
Taylor Nguyen: Nice. Is there a test mode to force 429s so my client backoff logic is exercised?
Rashida Ali: Yes: use the test proxy header `X-Emulate-429: after=20` — it will return a 429 on the 21st request from that connection. Also you can set `X-Emulate-RetryAfter: 2` to have the server include Retry-After: 2. Don't use the proxy for perf measurements.
Taylor Nguyen: And what's our recommended backoff for reconnects and retries?
Diego Morales: Exponential backoff with full jitter. Example: base 150ms, multiplier 2, max 3s. Reconnects for streaming: exponential but cap at ~10s to avoid reconnection storms.
Billing Bot: Note: ephemeral hosted keys outside onboarding credits will bill. If this test exceeds $25 estimate, please get manager sign-off.
Taylor Nguyen: My onboarding credits should cover it, but I'll confirm with manager. OPS-4957 updated with billing confirmation.
Rashida Ali: Approved and keys issued. I created two ephemeral hosted keys and whitelisted 34.200.11.7 for 2026-03-25 14:00-14:30 UTC. Keys will appear in Console -> API Keys -> Ephemeral.
Support Bot: Tip: Console -> Usage -> Realtime shows per-key QPS and 429s. Also `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/me | jq .key_type` shows key_type and expiry for ephemeral keys.
Taylor Nguyen: Thanks all, will run the test and report back. If I see persistent 429s after switching keys I'll ping Rashida. :rocket:
